T22/g0/r10: "PACT: O Devil, lord of darkness, I kneel before you. You are my god of justice. I devote myself to vice, slander, and every evil. The Bishop"
T22/g1/r7: Bishop: Jeanne d'Arc, granddaughter of Lugot the tavern keeper, was baptized by the Devil and became a slave to vile desires. By order of the Church, she is sentenced to death.
